subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw accept the operation-aware outbound delivery resolver and QQBot reconnect drain semantics in this PR as the core fix for the linked reconnect message-loss regression?
rationale: The code appears correct, but it intentionally changes shared delivery resolution and reconnect recovery behavior in compatibility-sensitive message paths, so green CI and contributor proof do not replace maintainer ownership of the rollout risk.

options.title: Accept Current Fix
options.body: Merge after maintainer review, keeping shared non-send resolvers ungated while using the operation-aware resolver only on delivery paths.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller patch that fixes only QQBot direct delivery first and leaves poll alignment or reconnect draining for follow-up work.

options.title: Pause For Replacement
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only if maintainers want a different resolver ownership model for delivery capability selection.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Fix
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review, keeping shared non-send resolvers ungated while using the operation-aware resolver only on delivery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and history show the strongest connection to the outbound/channel registry paths being changed.
